steps.code:
# Compute most common genre per playlist.
from collections import Counter

playlist_updates = []
for pl in playlists:
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    counter = Counter(genres)
    # Get the most common genre; if tie, pick the one with highest count (Counter.most_common returns in order of count, then insertion order)
    most_common = counter.most_common(1)[0][0]
    new_title = f"{pl['title']} | {most_common}"
    playlist_updates.append((pl['playlist_id'], new_title))
    print(pl['playlist_id'], pl['title'], '->', new_title)
